subject: Joint success playbook: kickoff and roles (Lifepoint POC)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Emma Ruiz <emma@lifepoint.com>, Carlos Vega <c.vega@lifepoint.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Joint success playbook: kickoff and roles (Lifepoint POC)

Hi Emma / Carlos —

Thanks for agreeing to run the 6-week POC with Redwood. I wanted to get a short mutual action plan (MAP) started so we have shared success criteria, owners, and dates. Attached is a first-pass MAP (MAP_v1_Lifepoint.pdf) and a lightweight benchmark template.

High-level goals I suggest we align on for the POC:
- Functional: extraction accuracy for discharge summaries (target: precision >= 0.88, recall >= 0.85 on the agreed sample)
- Latency: 95th percentile inference latency < 500ms for 512-token requests under baseline load
- Cost: target unit cost that keeps projected monthly inference spend within the committed budget range we discussed
- Security/compliance: no PHI persisted to shared caches; audit log retention policy agreed

Proposed owners (please confirm):
- Redwood AM / program owner: Sean Gallagher (me) — overall coordination and commercial decisioning
- Customer success / bench lead: Marissa Cole (marissa@redwood.com) — bench design, prompt set creation, eval harness
- Engineering / infra lead: Dev Patel (dev@redwood.com) — runtime config, quantization/throughput tuning, test harness

Suggested timeline (high level):
Week 0 (this week): kickoff, finalize success criteria & sample data agreement
Week 1: ingest sample data, baseline runs, procurement/security reviews
Weeks 2–3: benchmark iterations and prompt engineering; quantitative quality benching
Week 4: canary with production-like traffic and cost tuning
Week 5: consolidated results & final decision/next steps

Please confirm the stakeholder list (who will sign off on success), any mandatory procurement/legal gates, and whether the timeline above looks feasible. If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-minute kickoff tomorrow (30-min) to lock the MAP and owners.

Attachments: MAP_v1_Lifepoint.pdf, benchmark-template.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0168
From: Emma Ruiz <emma@lifepoint.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Carlos Vega <c.vega@lifepoint.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Lifepoint Procurement <procurement@lifepoint.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Joint success playbook: kickoff and roles (Lifepoint POC)

Sean — thanks, this is helpful. We are aligned on running a 6-week POC; I pulled in Procurement (procurement@lifepoint.com) and Carlos (clinical lead) who will own clinical signoff on metrics. A few quick notes: 

- Stakeholders who will sign off: Carlos Vega (Clinical), myself (Product Owner), Procurement (final purchase/contract gating)
- Procurement needs the scope-SLA.docx and a short SOC2 evidence checklist before Week 1 for legal review 
- Timeline: the procurement review may take the better part of Week 1; can we push bench-heavy work to Weeks 2–4 to avoid blocked compute runs?
- On success criteria: the precision/recall targets look right, but can we add an end-to-end throughput check (concurrent sessions 50 requests/min) so we validate operational behavior?

We can do a 30-minute kickoff Tuesday at 11am ET if that works for the Redwood team — Carlos and I prefer an in-calendar session to lock dates. Please share the Drive link and any short-read materials for procurement.

Best,
Emma Ruiz
Senior Product Manager | Lifepoint Health
emma@lifepoint.com | +1 (615) 555-2244

Emma / Sean / Carlos —

Agree with the suggested adjustments. Quick bench plan and owners from our side so you can slot people into your calendars: 

Bench plan (detailed):
- Sample: 250 discharge summaries (sanitized) split 70/30 train/validation; we will provide input format and artifacts by Tue EOD
- Eval metrics: extraction precision/recall (as Sean proposed), plus macro F1 for multi-field extraction; quality thresholds: precision >= 0.88, recall >= 0.85, F1 >= 0.86
- Operational: p95 latency target < 500ms on standard instances; concurrent throughput test at 50 requests/min with KV cache warm-up
- Cost: we'll run a simple cost model for projected monthly spend using your token estimates — please provide expected daily request volume by Tuesday

Owners and immediate asks: 
- Bench / prompt owner: Marissa Cole (I will own prompt curation, evaluation harness, and results deck) — marissa@redwood.com
- Runtime config / infra owner: Dev Patel (will provision test pool, quantization profile, and monitor p95) — dev@redwood.com
- Customer AM / milestone owner: Sean Gallagher (commercial checkpoints and final signoff)

Deliverables timeline (concrete):
- Tue (end of day): sanitized sample format + Drive folder (we will upload the benchmark-template.xlsx)
- Wed: baseline run results + initial prompt set
- End of Week 2: iterative benchmark results and tuning notes
- End of Week 4: canary report and consolidated scorecard

I attached the benchmark-template.xlsx and the MAP_v1_Lifepoint.pdf. I will create the results deck template in Drive and share the link after the kickoff.

If that matches your expectations, I can lead the kickoff and walk through the MAP on Tuesday.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Thanks — quick technical notes and a couple of attachments: benchmark-template.xlsx (filled with the initial fields) and scope-SLA.docx (scope + minimal SLA language for procurement).

- I can provision a dedicated test pool by Wednesday morning; it will be pre-configured for 512-token runs and a quantized float16 path to keep latency low. If you expect longer sequences or much higher concurrency please flag now.
- For the throughput test at 50 r/min, I recommend we run two 10-minute windows (one cold, one warm) to capture cache effects. I'll attach the small script we use for load runs if useful.
- Need an estimate of daily requests and expected peak concurrency from Lifepoint so I can provide a more accurate cost projection.

Attachments: benchmark-template.xlsx, scope-SLA.docx

—
Dev Patel
Senior Software Engineer (Platform) | Redwood Inference
